summary: This sermon explores the identity and role of the Holy Spirit, emphasizing the Spirit as advocate (paraclete) and spirit of truth based on Jesus's teaching in John 14-16. Shauna Rushing calls believers to actively engage with the Holy Spirit's presence and leading through looking, listening, learning, and leaning in with faith and obedience.
key_points: The Holy Spirit is the advocate/helper who comes alongside believers 24/7
The Holy Spirit is the spirit of truth who testifies to Jesus and guides into all truth
The Holy Spirit empowers believers through spiritual gifts and fruit
Practical steps: look for the Spirit's work, listen and slow down, learn from Scripture and others, lean in with faith despite discomfort
big_idea: The Holy Spirit is our ever-present advocate and spirit of truth who empowers us to participate in God's work, and we must actively look, listen, learn, and lean in to follow the Spirit's leading.
title: FAQ: Who is the Holy Spirit?
